section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the aims and hypotheses of a study investigating body appreciation correlates in men, specifically comparing heterosexual and sexual minority men. The study hypothesizes that body appreciation will be inversely correlated with conformity to masculine norms, upward appearance-based social comparisons, drive for muscularity and leanness, media consumption, perceived appearance pressures, and eating pathology, while being positively associated with physical activity and body satisfaction. The section emphasizes the need for body image interventions in men, as existing interventions are rare and often ineffective.
